summary: Your twenty-fourth Sunday review. You answer 9 questions on the README, the demo, the fresh clone, the pitch and the freeze with a confidence number, fill in your application numbers, prepare evidence for the six interview questions, rank what to polish before the workshop, list what you really ran, tag week 24 and plan the last week before the workshop.
goal: Review; decide what to polish for the workshop; plan week 25.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Fill in sent, answered, interviews and offers, and the one change for next week
Say each of the six interview answers aloud in 30 seconds with its evidence
Rank what to polish before the workshop, with no new features
Write exactly what you ran this module and what you could not run
Run git tag week-24, then plan week 25 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 3 to 5 applications
Play the Week 24 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
